active_design_subspace.claim: a declared 5D wing subspace of the 12D schema, never a 12D search

forbidden_lattices.why: numerically unstable on three of 24 common designs: CL explodes to 1e26-1e38 at alpha=5 and a full 0.5-12 degree sweep has no converging region; same designs are fine at 20x10 and 45x25

known_limitations: absolute CDi at 20x10 carries about 9% median error against 45x25; only same-lattice differences are used for ranking

one of 72 pre-registered designs returns a non-physical negative CDi at 20x10 (alpha 4.0-5.5 all negative) and is correctly rejected as NON_PHYSICAL_CDI, so a small part of the box is unlabelled rather than scored
Trefftz CDi excludes wave drag; RCAIDE compressibility term returns NaN on this vehicle
the task family covers Mach 1.6-2.4 at 18,288 m with a fixed per-task lift; the envelope is a candidate range, not a verified flight envelope

production_lattice.why: the 100k campaign compares designs inside one lattice; 20x10 keeps the 69,120-evaluation S4 block inside a few hours on 8-12 workers

verification_lattice.why: S6 final recheck only; 10.5x slower per evaluation, so it is not the production lattice

workers.why: throughput saturates by 8 workers (232.66 eval/min); 8->16 adds 27% throughput but doubles p50 latency
